---
title: Research tools lab
---

## What the labs are for

The labs will help students use LLM-agent tools in economic research, alongside Git and other conventional research tools. The emphasis is on planning a research task, using tools effectively, checking results, and keeping work reproducible.

Python remains useful infrastructure, but learning Python syntax is no longer the central lab objective.

## Before the first lab

Tool selection and setup instructions will be added after the lab activities are agreed. No paid subscription, agent platform, or installation is required by this placeholder.

## Weekly structure

Each week's lab will specify the research task, the tools and workflow, an in-class activity, and the expected deliverable. Each weekly page also reserves separate homework reading and exercise sections.

## Optional background

Students who need Python background can consult @quantecon-python and @coding-economists. Previous Python-focused labs are preserved in the [repository archive](https://github.com/YaolangZhong/U_Tokyo_Comp_Econ_Course/tree/main/archive/legacy_labs) for potential reuse; they are not the new lab schedule.
